card.name: French elision before an apostrophe
card.fires_on: The letter l or d (or similar short piece) right before an apostrophe in French phrases such as "Sur l'amour" or "raison d'être" in general web text. It also fires on a word just before a closing quote mark.

modes.label: French elision
modes.description: A lone l or d standing before an apostrophe in French titles and names.

modes.label: Word before closing quote
modes.description: A quoted word or fragment that is about to be followed by a closing quote mark.

card.writes: It promotes quotation marks of several kinds and suppresses code-like tokens and curly single quotes, so it favors a straight double quote next.
card.plain: It spots a French l' or d' or a quoted word where a quotation mark is about to follow.
